name: RFC Documentation Generator
shortDescription: Generate IETF-compliant RFC documentation from source code
longDescription: A comprehensive Claude-Code plugin that automatically generates and maintains RFC-style technical documentation from your source code. Uses specialized AI agents with Serena MCP for semantic code analysis, producing IETF-compliant documentation with bidirectional traceability, incremental updates, and preservation of manual edits.
features: Generate RFC-style documentation from source code
Incremental updates that preserve manual edits

commands.name: /rfc-generate
commands.description: Generate initial RFC documentation from source code

commands.name: /rfc-update
commands.description: Update existing RFC documentation after code changes

commands.name: /rfc-analyze-impact
commands.description: Analyze impact of code changes on documentation
